propositions: ProductionBatchRunner.run receives req.usd_budget as a cost cap override but cannot apply it because run_pass1 and shed_to_budget compute the cap internally with no injection point
The existing REBAR_PLAN_REVIEW_BUDGET environment variable is not a true cap override because it is read as a base and then centrality-scaled, not applied verbatim
An optional cap_override parameter must thread through ProductionBatchRunner.run -> run_pass1 -> shed_to_budget, applied verbatim without centrality scaling, with None selecting computed cap behavior
coverage[budget] must record cap_source as either 'override' or 'computed' to make observable which cap governed a run
The plan-review gate YAML currently sets no usd_budget on its finders batch, so live gate behavior remains unchanged until cost-policy decisions separately start setting a budget
